metadata.title: Deriv Multi-Market Rise/Fall V1.8.2 Authoritative Evidence Package

assumptions_and_limitations.naive_independent: Assumes zero serial correlation between consecutive ticks (grossly invalid for overlapping contracts).
assumptions_and_limitations.duration_divided_heuristic: Approximates correlation length as duration D. Simple and robust for order-of-magnitude correction.
assumptions_and_limitations.empirical_autocorrelation: Integrates observed outcome autocorrelation rho(k). More sequence-adaptive but sensitive to sample noise.
assumptions_and_limitations.moving_block_bootstrap: Distribution-free resampling preserving local dependency blocks. Does not assume normality.
assumptions_and_limitations.non_overlapping_decimation: Subsamples every D ticks to enforce true independence, at the cost of discarding (D-1)/D observations.

assumptions_and_limitations.naive_independent: Assumes zero serial correlation between consecutive ticks (grossly invalid for overlapping contracts).
assumptions_and_limitations.duration_divided_heuristic: Approximates correlation length as duration D. Simple and robust for order-of-magnitude correction.
assumptions_and_limitations.empirical_autocorrelation: Integrates observed outcome autocorrelation rho(k). More sequence-adaptive but sensitive to sample noise.
